People: George Manville Fenn (author, Wikidata Q644784), died 1909; Henri Théophile Hildibrand (illustrator, Wikidata Q3132072), died 1897; Edouard Riou (illustrator, Wikidata Q583275), died 1900. Printed edition: Off to the wilds : being the adventures of two brothers, Sampson Low, Marston, Searle, And Rivington, London, 1881, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/dli.ministry.24659. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 88%, 93%, 94% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Henri Théophile Hildibrand, Edouard Riou, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
